{{Quote|TD-1123 was small like me, a crack shot. She got killed by an abo in a firefight at Jiroch-Reslia. I never knew where she was from.|Isila Drutch|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
"'''TD-1123'''" was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] in the [[291st Legion/Legends|291st Legion Dalisor]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] while fighting on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Jiroch-Reslia]], and she was later mentioned in the memoirs of her compatriot [[Isila Drutch]].
